clips.caption:
You say you want $20,000 a month. Maybe $100,000. Maybe $10 million in the bank and no debt.

Kevin Trudeau says that is only your conscious intention. Below it, in your subconscious, there is often the exact opposite one: stay poor.

So you push the gas and the brake at the same time - and then wonder why all that effort goes nowhere.

Every money course teaches the gas pedal. Almost none of them mention the brake.

Which one have you been pressing harder?

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #subconsciousmind #wealthmindset #selfsabotage #financialfreedom

Money doesn't grow on trees. We were born on the wrong side of the tracks. We're workers. Rich people are miserable.

Kevin Trudeau calls these counter intentions - beliefs handed down through a family until they feel like facts.

You can be working hard on making money while one of them quietly sabotages every effort, because underneath, it says you shouldn't have it.

His point: until you clear it out, the struggle keeps coming back no matter how hard you work.

Which of these did you grow up hearing?

#kevintrudeau #moneybeliefs #mindset #generationalwealth #wealthmindset #subconsciousmind

Kevin Trudeau's mother kept the house. His father was a welder. Neither went to college.

Their truth was simple: people like us don't get rich. Rich people are born into it, go to college, become doctors and lawyers. That's not our destiny.

On top of it came the warnings - money leads to trouble, rich people can't trust anyone, an honest day's pay is all you deserve.

None of it was said to hurt him. It was what they knew. And it went into him anyway.

What did your parents believe about money?

#kevintrudeau #bluecollar #moneymindset #familymoney #mindsetshift #wealthmindset

You tried to make money once and it failed. The embarrassment, the people who laughed - it stung.

Kevin Trudeau says your mind files that away the same way it filed the first time you touched a hot stove: trying to make money leads to pain.

From then on, part of you works against you. You hesitate, you pick the wrong move, you do something careless - and nobody sees why.

It also happens to people who made money and then lost it all.

What failure is still running your money decisions?

#kevintrudeau #failure #selfsabotage #moneymindset #mindset #entrepreneur

One man sees a $300 course on making money online and decides it's probably a scam. He never takes the next step.

The second buys it and never opens the videos. The third watches every video the first night and never starts. The fourth starts, keeps going for a month - and quits in the middle.

Kevin Trudeau says all four are the same thing wearing different clothes: a counter intention stopping them before the result.

It isn't the course. It's what stops you from finishing it.

Which of the four have you been?

#kevintrudeau #procrastination #selfsabotage #consistency #moneymindset #entrepreneur

Kevin Trudeau started his first business with $100 he'd saved from shoveling snow and delivering newspapers. Direct mail, from his house.

It was a struggle. Ads that should have worked didn't. It felt like walking uphill with something pushing back.

His mentor helped him clear one belief that was working against him. He went back to the same business, changed one word in one headline - and the money started pouring in.

He made over a million dollars before he turned 18.

What would change if your work stopped feeling like a struggle?

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #directmail #youngentrepreneur #moneymindset #success

Picture a hill. At the top is everything you want. There is a clear path straight up.

You start climbing and it is exhausting. You stop, slide back, start again, and keep asking why this is so hard.

What you can't see, Kevin Trudeau says, is the thousand pounds of rocks strapped to your back. Those are your counter intentions.

Drop the rocks and the same hill feels easy. Clear all of them and it's like taking the gondola to the top.

What's in your backpack?

#kevintrudeau #success #mindset #moneymindset #selfimprovement #wealthmindset
